learning_outcomes.text: Sizes passive solar energy devices. Plans for solar energy panels (photovoltaic).
Examines and compares types of wind energy use. Calculates efficiency for wind farms. Determines wave energy and its usability.
Calculates capacity for hydraulic resources. Determines efficiency and reliability criteria for hydraulic resources.
Applies and develops methods and techniques for using geothermal resources as an energy source.
Examines and classifies production techniques for biological fuels with zero carbon dioxide balance (bio gasoline, bio diesel, biomass).

syllabus_topics: Sun, fusion reaction, and the power emitted by the sun
Solar constant and solar energy systems
Hydraulic resources and their importance for Turkey
Peak load problem and energy quality, availability
Wave energy and its value as a resource
Biomass and biogas production and storage
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 50% from the final exam and 50% from in-year achievement. In-year achievement is based on two short exams (20% each) and one midterm exam (60%).
bibliography: Tahsin Engin, Önder Kaşka, Nehir Tokgöz, Ceyhun Yılmaz. (2022). Yenilenebilir Enerji Temelleri ve Uygulamaları. Palme Yayınevi, Ankara.

Yilmaz, C., Kanoglu, M., & Abusoglu, A. (2018). Thermoeconomic Optimization of Hydrogen Production and Liquefaction by Geothermal Power. In Exergy for A Better Environment and Improved Sustainability 2 (pp. 951-966). Springer, Cham.
